messages:
Mia Chen: Hey team — quick onboarding check for galena-v1. Weights were uploaded to gs://redwood-models/galena/v1/weights.safetensors. Can someone confirm manifest + tokenizer pair and flag anything blocking deploy?
Sam Patel: I pulled the manifest. It references tokenizer at gs://redwood-models/galena/v1/tokenizer.json but CI token-lint is failing with \"unexpected control-char in vocab\". Seems like a delim/escape issue.
Jordan Reese: We hit that before with older tokenizers from the vendor. They used 0x01 as an internal join-char and didn't escape it in merges, so some vocab entries contain raw control bytes.
Mia Chen: Repro for me: when I run our quick check `python -m rwinf.tools.tokenizer_check --tokenizer gs://redwood-models/galena/v1/tokenizer.json --sample 'Hello\\nWorld'` the token counts differ if the sample uses LF vs CRLF. That breaks our chat alignment assumptions.
Sam Patel: Repro steps I used locally:
```
# sample with CRLF endings
python -m rwinf.tools.tokenizer_check --tokenizer ./tokenizer.json --file samples/crlf_sample.txt
```
Output: token_count: 22
Mia Chen: The immediate user-facing risk: our chat templates assume we normalize newlines to `\\n` at the preprocessor. If tokenizer treats `\\r` differently token indices shift and KV-cache offsets drift for long dialogs.
nina-bot: CI: tokenizer-lint failed for galena-v1 (job id: 4821). Logs: https://ci.redwood/4821
DevOps: Quick ops question — are these weights in the staging bucket or prod? We should snapshot the path before promoting to Dedicated.
Mia Chen: Staging bucket for now. Proposed plan:
1) Sam patches tokenizer.json to escape control bytes (0x01) and runs tokenizer-lint --fix.
2) Jordan adds a small normalizer in the request preprocessor to collapse CRLF->LF before tokenization.
3) DevOps snapshots staging path and adds an allowlist for PR jobs.
Sam Patel: Opening a tiny PR now: https://git.redwood/p/galena-tokenizer-fix (draft). Patch performs an explicit replace on problematic vocab entries and reserializes merges. Running local lint fix.
Jordan Reese: For the preprocessor change I propose adding: `text = text.replace('\\r\\n', '\\n')` in the API entrypoint and a unit test that feeds a CRLF-heavy chat to ensure token offsets are stable.
Mia Chen: Agreed. After Sam's tokenizer fix we should run token-coverage compare: `tools/compare_token_coverage --model gs://redwood-models/galena/v1/weights.safetensors --tokenizer gs://redwood-models/galena/v1/tokenizer_fixed.json` to validate logits alignment on seed prompts.
Sam Patel: Patch pushed to draft, local tests for token counts pass. Triggering CI rerun. I'll post results here once lint completes.
DevOps: I'm snapshotting the staging bucket now — snapshot name: `galena/v1-staging-snap-2026-03-18`. Also adding the PR job to allowlist. ETA ~30m.
Mia Chen: Thanks. Moving this async: follow-ups are run full eval after tokenizer fix and verify KV cache behavior for long chats. I'll update thread when CI finishes.
nina-bot: CI update: tokenizer-lint job rerun queued by PR (id: 4830).
Sam Patel: Rerun queued. Will paste results in this thread.
